description: On-chain outcome verification for agent swaps, on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.2.0). create_commitment, withdraw_for_swap, mock_swap_execute, submit_proof and release were verified end-to-end: 1_000_000 input units were locked, swapped 1:1, marked Passed from the output ATA balance, and released to the payer. Official program ids were not reused.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Portaudit/trustrail-pipelines. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/trustrail-pipelines. The lab changed declare_id for trustrail_pipelines and mock_swap to unique Sol.College devnet programs. The hosted IDLs are hand-derived subsets confirmed by the verifying transactions. mock_swap is a 1:1 transfer stand-in, not a real AMM. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_commitment, withdraw_for_swap, submit_proof, release, mock_swap_execute)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/trustrail-pipelines/
QA: devnet proof of the Passed path through release
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
refund, cancel, recover, real AMM venues

assignments.title: Exercise submit_proof when output is below min_output_amount and follow refund
